verdict.rationale: Carta ships its own documented API platform, but the evidence shows mostly read-only v1alpha1 endpoints (cap table, stakeholders, option grants, convertible notes, FMVs). Write operations appear only in narrow cases: creating draft option grants and draft issuers. Nothing shows the API matching what users can do in the UI. Missing for 10: any documented claim or evidence of API–UI parity, write/mutation coverage beyond drafts (e.g., issuing securities, approvals, transfers, exercises), and independent or hands-on corroboration of breadth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
